teaser: Companies already have behaviour policies: RiskMandate's job is to turn approved business mandates into tested controls and keep them true.
core_idea: Companies already approve behaviour policies for people, delegated authority, four-eyes, data handling and limits, so RiskMandate's role is to convert those approved business mandates into agent behaviour policies, generate controls on existing enforcement points or say plainly where a requirement cannot be enforced, verify them against the protected systems, and maintain the evidence as deployments change, proven first on one real workflow.
